name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
description: Financial, technical and business support for micro food processing units, farmer producer organizations, and self-help groups across India.
benefitSummary: Credit linked capital subsidy @35% of eligible project cost up to max ₹10 lakh per unit.
beneficiary: Micro food processing individual units, FPOs, SHGs, Co-operatives
applicationSteps: Register on the official PMFME online portal (mofpi.gov.in/pmfme)
Fill applicant details and upload business profile
Submit Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Application forwarded to District Level Committee (DLC)
Bank sanction and subsidy disbursement

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
description: Collateral-free credit facility provided by eligible lending institutions to collateral-starved micro and small enterprises.
benefitSummary: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Crore with guarantee coverage up to 85% for eligible MSEs.
beneficiary: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises
documents: Financial Statements / ITR for existing units
applicationSteps: Approach a Member Lending Institution (Scheduled Commercial Banks, RRBs, NBFCs)
Submit loan proposal with Udyam Registration
Bank evaluates credit proposal
Bank registers loan under CGTMSE guarantee portal
Loan sanctioned without collateral requirement

name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme
description: Capital investment subsidy for technology modernization in textile and apparel manufacturing sectors.
benefitSummary: 10% to 15% Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) up to ₹30 Crore depending on segment.
beneficiary: Textile manufacturing units acquiring eligible benchmarked machinery
documents: Machinery Purchase Invoices and Installation Certificate
applicationSteps: Register unit on i-TUFS portal (itufs.gov.in)
Apply for UARN (Unique Application Reference Number) before machinery shipment
Procure and install benchmarked machinery
Joint Inspection conducted by Textile Commissioner office
Subsidy credited to loan account

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
benefitSummary: Margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost (up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for service).
beneficiary: Individuals above 18 years, SHGs, Institutions, Co-operative societies
documents: VIII Standard Pass Certificate (for projects above ₹10L manufacturing)
applicationSteps: Fill online application on KVIC e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal)
Select agency (KVIC, KVIB, or District Industries Centre - DIC)
Upload project report and photo/documents
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview
Bank sanction and 2-week EDP training prior to subsidy release

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
description: Financial assistance for Zero Defect Zero Effect certification to improve quality, reduce wastage, and enhance environmental sustainability.
benefitSummary: Up to 80% subsidy on certification cost (Micro: 80%, Small: 60%, Medium: 50%) + additional concessions.
applicationSteps: Register on ZED Portal using Udyam number
Take ZED Pledge
Complete online self-assessment for Bronze certification
Apply for Silver/Gold certification and desktop/site assessment
Receive ZED certificate and subsidy reimbursement

name: Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI) 2019 - Maharashtra
description: State industrial policy incentive offering SGST reimbursement, interest subsidy, and stamp duty exemption to industrial units in Maharashtra.
benefitSummary: Incentives including SGST reimbursement up to 100% of Fixed Capital Investment, 5% interest subsidy, and Electricity Duty exemption.
beneficiary: New and Expansion MSME units in Maharashtra (specially Vidarbha, Marathwada, and backward talukas)
documents: Industrial Building Plan Approval / Land Ownership
Chartered Accountant Certificate of Fixed Capital Investment
applicationSteps: Register on Maharashtra Maitri Portal (mahitri.maharashtra.gov.in)
Submit Eligibility Certificate (EC) application to General Manager, DIC
Site inspection by District Industries Centre officer
Issuance of Eligibility Certificate
Annual claim submission for SGST & interest subsidy disbursement

name: Market Access Initiative (MAI) Scheme
description: Financial assistance for export promotion activities, trade fairs, statutory compliance, and market studies in focus export destinations.
benefitSummary: Airfare reimbursement up to 60-75% for attending international trade fairs + stall space subsidy.
benefitAmount: Financial reimbursement for export marketing & fairs
beneficiary: Exporter MSMEs, Export Promotion Councils, Trade Bodies
documents: Valid Passport and Visa of participant
Air travel invoices and Boarding passes
applicationSteps: Apply through designated Export Promotion Council (EPC) or FIEO
Submit pre-registration prior to trade event
Participate in recognized international expo/trade fair
Submit claim form with boarding passes and invoices within 90 days
Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) of grant

name: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation, Design, IPR)
description: Support for commercialization of innovative ideas, design expertise reimbursement, and patent/trademark filing subsidies.
benefitSummary: Grant up to ₹15 Lakh per idea for Incubation + up to ₹40 Lakh for plant & machinery for commercialization.
benefitAmount: Idea Grant up to ₹15L + Design/IPR Reimbursement
applicationSteps: Register on MSME Ideas Portal (my.msme.gov.in/incubation)
Submit idea proposal choosing a Host Institute (HI)
Host Institute evaluates and recommends proposal
PMAC (Project Monitoring & Advisory Committee) approval
Fund disbursement in stages

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
benefitSummary: Bank loan covering up to 85% of project cost (₹10L to ₹100L) with competitive interest rate and credit guarantee.
beneficiary: SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneurs setting up greenfield (first-time) ventures
applicationSteps: Apply online via Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or visit bank branch
Fill online lead form and upload project details
Connect with Lead District Manager (LDM) or preferred bank branch
Sanction of loan and margin money arrangement
Disbursement and mentoring support

name: Micro and Small Enterprises Cluster Development Programme
description: Financial assistance for setting up Common Facility Centres (CFCs) and Infrastructure Development in MSME industrial clusters.
benefitSummary: Grant up to 80% of project cost for Common Facility Centres (CFC) up to ₹30 Crore project limit.
benefitAmount: Grant up to 80% for Cluster CFCs
beneficiary: Consortium / SPV of minimum 20 MSE units in a cluster
applicationSteps: Form a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) with cluster units
Submit Diagnostic Study Report to State Directorate of Industries
State Level Steering Committee forwards to DC MSME
Approval by Steering Committee at Ministry level
Grant release in tranches for CFC setup
